name: Vinext S.p.A.
summary: Vinext S.p.A., a winemaking technology and environmental company, engages in the designing, research, production, testing, and marketing of products and machinery for oenology and brewing. The company provides EquilibriO2 system, managing gas concentration in wine; EquiBrew, a system for managing dissolved gases in beer and water de-oxygenation; reverse osmosis, an osmotic membrane separation system; cross-flow filtration systems; and micro-oxygenation systems. It also offers biotechnological and chemical products for the wine industry, such as yeasts, enzymes, and other biotechnologies; and water management solutions in recovery and reuse of processed water, and co2 recovery and reuse. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Buonalbergo, Italy. Vinext S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of VI.MA. srl
